name: VoxSRC 2023 Track 4
description: This report describes the submission system by the GIST-AiTeR team for the VoxCeleb Speaker Recognition Challenge 2023 (VoxSRC-23) Track 4. Our submission system focuses on implementing diverse speaker diarization (SD) techniques, including ResNet293 and MFA-Conformer with different combinations of segment and hop length. Then, those models are combined into an ensemble model. The ResNet293 and MFA-Conformer models exhibited the diarization error rates (DERs) of 3.65% and 3.83% on VAL46, respectively. The submitted ensemble model provided a DER of 3.50% on VAL46, and consequently, it achieved a DER of 4.88% on the VoxSRC-23 test set.
reputation: VoxSRC is a well-known annual community benchmark for speaker recognition and diarization, widely used to compare state-of-the-art systems.
notes: Challenge benchmark with leaderboard-style evaluation; lower DER is better. Results are highly system- and track-dependent, and performance can vary with segmentation, clustering, and ensemble methods.
